subject: OptiScale: observability add-on packaging and quote
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Leah Porter <leah.porter@optiscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Observability add-ons: initial packaging and numbers

Hi Leah,

Thanks again for the call this morning — it was helpful to understand OptiScale's usage profile. Per our discussion, I'm sharing an initial packaging approach for the observability add-ons you asked about (retention, tracing, advanced dashboards). I've attached a short quote and a draft SOW for review.

Highlights:
- Retention tiers: 30d / 90d / 365d. We see most customers on the 90d tier for production, with hotspot customers choosing 365d for compliance.
- Tracing: 90d hot storage with 365d cold archive option (hot = full span search, cold = read-only archive).
- Advanced dashboards: seat-based admin + metered dashboards for heavy query users.

Proposed starter configuration for OptiScale (monthly billable):
- 90d retention (primary): 2 TB ingested / month
- Tracing 90d hot (50k traces/day avg)
- Advanced dashboards: 10 admin seats + 50 metered dashboard units

Pricing summary (list price):
- Retention 90d: $3,200/mo
- Tracing 90d hot: $2,400/mo
- Advanced dashboards bundle: $1,200/mo
Total list: $6,800/mo

We can offer a pilot concession for the first 3 months (50% off add-ons) to validate value and dashboards adoption. For committed 12-month purchases we typically apply a volume discount (10-20%) depending on ingestion/seat commitments.

Next steps: if you can share the procurement timeline and target PO cadence, I’ll loop in Karthik to produce a formal quote and SOW that aligns to your payment and audit needs.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: RDW-Quote-OptiScale-0126.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
Attachment: SOW-OptiScale-Observability.docx (DOCX, 5 pages)

From: Leah Porter <leah.porter@optiscale.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: initial packaging and numbers

Thanks Naomi — appreciate the quick follow-up and the attachments. A few clarifying items from our side:

1) Retention: we are leaning toward 90d for logs, but we need 365d for traces tied to compliance for a specific customer. Can you price a hybrid (90d logs + 365d traces with cold archive)?
2) Discounting: our procurement handbook targets a minimum of 25% off list for multi-year commitments. The pilot concession is helpful, but procurement will want a stronger committed discount if we sign a 12-month PO.
3) Dashboards: is there an option to make dashboards entirely metered (no admin seat surcharge) for the pilot?

Procurement: I’m looping procurement at procurement@optiscale.com and attaching our internal checklist — they’ll need a breakdown by SKU and a standard invoice flow.

Can you also confirm whether trace data egress for exports is charged separately?

Cheers,
Leah Porter
Head of Infrastructure, OptiScale
leah.porter@optiscale.com

Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: initial packaging and numbers

Thanks Leah — good questions.

Answers and refined offer:
- Hybrid retention: yes, we can do 90d logs + 365d traces. The pricing delta for trace cold archive (+read-only) is an incremental $900/mo. So hybrid total (keeping prior usage numbers) becomes $7,700/mo list.
- Committed discount path: for a 12-month committed contract (annual billing) we can offer 18% off list on the add-ons if OptiScale commits to the starter configuration I outlined. If you want a 24-month commit, we can go to 25% off. The pilot 3-month 50% concession would be separate and applied to months 1-3, then the committed discount would apply for months 4-12.
- Dashboards: we can make dashboards metered-only for the pilot (remove the admin seat surcharge for the initial 3 months). After the pilot, we recommend 2 admin seats for audit and governance; those can be optional on renewal.
- Egress: trace exports (sideload to S3/third-party) are metered at 0.02/GB; standard API exports for troubleshooting are included within the quota.

To make procurement work smoother, we can provide: a) a per-SKU breakout sheet, b) a simple pilot SOW with success criteria, and c) a standard invoice template that maps to PO fields you need.

If that sounds reasonable I’ll have Karthik draft a formal quote and attach the SOW for signatures.

Regards,
Naomi
